INSERT INTO cart_item (`id`, `user_id`, `sku_id`, `quantity`, `selected`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `deleted`, `version`) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, 1, NOW(), NOW(), 0, 0) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
`quantity` = LEAST( IF(`cart_item`.`deleted` = 1, `new`.`quantity`, `cart_item`.`quantity` + `new`.`quantity`), #{maxQuantity}),
`selected` = 1, `deleted` = 0, `update_time` = NOW(), `version` = `cart_item`.`version` + 1
